body: REVIEW ADDENDUM — I replaced my formal BLOCK by CAS at review op 20260901T083922.767768Z-p32620-c0000-r021a-h62535e so the eventual successor receives both findings at once. The Code Red omissions remain finding 1. Finding 2 is independent and source-bound: at base b73692f, SemanticDistance is documented as a distance in [0,1], but its public constructors wrap arbitrary Double and CandidateGenerator sorts/publishes it. The current court admits every finite value, so finite -1.0 or 2.0 would pass sections 2/2.1 and M1 despite violating the channel contract. The successor must declare and enforce each score channel domain before sort/take and include finite out-of-range semantic controls. This does not widen implementation authority or alter the existing hold.
